note: Aggregation over repeated runs is worst-case: min for >= criteria, max for <= criteria. A metric that cannot be computed is NOT_EVALUATED, which is not a pass.

module_baseline.source: metacheck inst/modules/marginal.R <validation> note: 51 papers, 87 statements (extraction task)

criteria.why: adjudication may drop at most 5 percentage points of the true issues the generator found (candidate recall minus final recall; sweep gains offset losses)
insufficient_evidence / not_checked / no finding, over candidates whose label is decidable
candidates that received a valid verdict other than not_checked
no confirmed_issue where labellers judged the evidence unavailable
minimum held-out positives, so precision/recall are not decided by a handful of items
